items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Gene said, 'Don't worry. Everything is okay. I'll take care of you.' ... with the help of Gene. Everything came just so easily, because he was so patient and such a wonderful person.

ctx.x: I didn't know what to do. So first night, Gene said, "Don't worry. Everything is okay. I'll take care of you." So, oh, about a week, then I got the swing of things, with the help of Gene. Everything came just so easily, because he was so patient and such a wonderful person.
And you had that natural feeling for it.
